title: Edge: early completion, reversal/void, and serviced-now-invoiced-later
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Complete a compliance service months early and confirm nothing warns or confirms.
  2. Where a cycle fell back to the invoice date, reverse and re-invoice and confirm it recalculates from the new invoice (unless a later completion superseded it).
  3. Void an invoice (credit memo) and confirm the original date is left intact.
  4. Mark complete on Monday a truck invoiced three weeks later and confirm the next cycle counts from Monday and the worklist shows nothing due in between.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Early completion is normal: fleets move compliance work months earlier and nothing warns or confirms.
  • Where a cycle fell back to the invoice date, reversing and re-invoicing recalculates it from the new invoice, unless a later completion has already superseded it.
  • A voided invoice is not a case: reversal is a credit memo and leaves the original date intact.
  • A truck serviced Monday and invoiced three weeks later is marked complete on Monday and counts its next cycle from Monday; the worklist shows nothing due in between and invoicing later changes nothing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-E1: “Early completion is normal. Fleets move compliance work months earlier to fit a slow season, and nothing warns or confirms”
  • S18-E2: “Where a cycle fell back to the invoice date per S18-R13, reversing and re-invoicing the work order recalculates it from the new invoice, unless a later completion has already superseded it”
  • S18-E3: “A voided invoice is not a case. Reversal is a credit memo and leaves the original date intact”
  • S18-E8: “A truck serviced on Monday and invoiced three weeks later is marked complete on Monday and counts its next cycle from Monday. The worklist shows nothing due for it in between, and invoicing later changes nothing”
